component-o.description-s: Dual GMSL2 (6Gbps/3Gbps forward, 187.5Mbps reverse) to MIPI CSI-2 Deserializer, 48-pin TQFN-SW

notes-as: 50 ohm single-ended (coax) or 100 ohm differential (STP) traces only; minimise length, no sharp bends
AC-coupling capacitors within 500 mil (12.7 mm) of the SIOx pins; component pads directly on the trace (no stubs)
ground cutouts under the high-speed pads, 1.3x the pad area; stitch ground layers with vias along the traces
PoC: smallest (highest-SRF) inductor on the signal trace, within 1/2 UI of the device; cutouts under the first two inductors and resistors

source-o.pages-s: p48 (50 ohm coax or 100 ohm STP), p67 (High-Speed GMSL Traces, PoC layout)

cfgpins-ao.4c: I2C/UART control-channel select strap latched at power-up per Table 12 CFG0 Input Map; resistor divider from VDDIO to CFG0 pin to ground sets primary I2C address / interface Strap set from the datasheet's CFG0 input map, row I2C/0x50: R1 OPEN, R2 10k.

cfgpins-ao.8c: Coax/STP mode and forward-link rate select strap latched at power-up per Table 13 CFG1 Input Map; resistor divider from VDDIO to CFG1 pin to ground selects 6Gbps coax tunnel mode (row 88.3%: R1=10k, R2=OPEN) Strap set from the datasheet's CFG1 input map, row COAX/6/Tunnel: R1 32.4k, R2 68.1k.

cfgpins-ao.1c: Active-low power-down input; internal 1MΩ pulldown to ground by default. Tie to VDDIO through pull-up (or drive from host) to keep device out of standby; do not float during normal operation.

cfgpins-ao.10c: Default function is SDA_RX (I2C/UART data pass-through). Open-drain pin with internal 40kΩ pull-up to VDDIO by default; add external I2C pull-up per bus loading if internal pull-up insufficient.

cfgpins-ao.11c: Default function is SCL_TX (I2C/UART clock pass-through). Open-drain pin with internal 40kΩ pull-up to VDDIO by default; add external I2C pull-up per bus loading if internal pull-up insufficient.

cfgpins-ao.15c: Connect a single 402Ω ±1% resistor (RXRES) from XRES pin to ground; required external reference resistor for internal bias/termination calibration.

cfgpins-ao.12c: X1/OSC: 25MHz ±200ppm crystal to X2 (xtal-ao ref), load capacitor X1/OSC to EP; or drive a 25MHz ±200ppm oscillator here and leave X2 open (then drop xtal-ao)

cfgpins-ao.13c: X2: second crystal terminal, load capacitor X2 to EP (crystal maker's value); open when an oscillator drives X1/OSC

cfgpins-ao.14c: RSVD: no connect -- the datasheet labels it "Do Not Connect" beside the pin (page 27); left open.
